text:
maya: ok so this morning my ethernet drop got munched by... the neighbor's robot lawnmower? no joke. live demo: pic in thread. :mower:
trent: wait what. how does that even happen
maya: it finished a pass, hit the cable that runs along the curb, tripped the tether and scalped about 6ft
samir: that's... a very committed mower. any chance it's alive? :eyes:
maya: cable is frayed, lights on my switch went dark. tried the usual: power cycle, check modem LEDs, nothing
olivia: can you share model of modem? sometimes that one has a reset hole you can press for 10s
maya: pico-net X400. i did a soft reset. may have to dig out the crimper and do a splice. also my backup is my phone hotspot which is fine for email but my mic lags in calls
trent: pro tip: if you have an old laptop with an ethernet port, you can usb-tether it to phone and bridge. i did that last month during fiber work
maya: connecting to phone now. audio still meh. will throw in a request for a replacement run to infra.
ops-bot: INCIDENT CREATED: #WFH-ROBOTMOW-57 — "Ethernet cut: curb run". Assigned to network-team. ETA 48h.
samir: hardware glory idea: label the "mower-killed" cable with a tiny flag and photo for posterity. we should have a WFH hazard gallery
olivia: also, reminder: if you splice, use heat shrink and weatherproof tape. don't just twist and hope. learned that the hard way.
maya: found spare cat5 in garage labeled "from old ikea shelf". test link shows link light! partial success. speed is 80/20Mbps now
trent: nice. file this under "weird causes of degraded latency" along with "baby crying + vacuums"
ops-bot: REMINDER: submit expense if you buy tools. code: WFH-MAINT
olivia: anyone got recommendations for a telescoping conduit or surface-mount raceway to prevent future attacks? i use 1" PVC channel and zip ties
samir: quick poll: should we start a monthly thread called "WFH disasters & fixes"? react :thumbsup: for yes, :eyes: for maybe
maya: attaching a couple of photos and a short video clip. note: the mower model has a sweet little bluetooth speaker you can steal for playlists
trent: mark me down for helping with reroute this weekend if you want an extra pair of hands
maya: appreciate it. will try a temp splice and then schedule a proper tuck into the lawn edge next week
samir: official reaction count summary: :thumbsup:8, :mower:4, :joy:6
ops-bot: NOTE: ticket updated with photos. priority: medium
maya: thanks all. lesson learned: never assume curb cable is immune to robo-yards.
